# PRESTOplay Web Code Samples

> Runnable code samples for PRESTOplay for Web Apps (npm: `@castlabs/prestoplay`),
> castLabs' browser video player SDK for DASH and HLS. Each sample is a single
> self-contained HTML file. The PRESTOplay code is in the
> `<script type="module">` block in `<head>`. Each block starts with a comment
> listing the modules, external dependencies, APIs and gotchas for that sample.

The rest of each HTML file is page scaffolding and is not needed in an app: the
import map, the `<prestoplay-header>` component, `examples/styles.css`, and the
inline styles.

## Core concepts

- The SDK is split into modules. `@castlabs/prestoplay` (`cl.core.js`) exports
  the `clpp` namespace. Feature modules are imported only for their side
  effects, before a player is created:
  `import "@castlabs/prestoplay/cl.mse"`.
- `cl.mse` provides playback through Media Source Extensions and is needed by
  every sample. Add `cl.dash` for DASH and `cl.hls` for HLS.
- Each feature has its own module: `cl.playlist`, `cl.thumbnails`, `cl.ima`
  (Google IMA ads), `cl.vtt` (WebVTT and SRT subtitles), `cl.ttml` (TTML
  subtitles), `cl.htmlcue` (HTML subtitle renderer), `cl.conviva`,
  `cl.muxdata` and `cl.youbora` (NPAW).
- The samples load the SDK through an import map that points at files in
  `node_modules`. In an app that uses a bundler, import the same specifiers
  directly; there is no import map.
- Include `@castlabs/prestoplay/clpp.styles.css` for the player UI styles.
- HLS samples load `mux.js` as a global `<script>` before the SDK. It
  transmuxes MPEG-TS and raw AAC segments for MSE playback.
- Creating a player:
  `new clpp.Player(videoElOrId, playerConfig, {containerEl})`. Plugin settings
  go in `playerConfig` (e.g. `{conviva: {...}}`). Per-content settings go in
  `player.open({source, autoplay, ...})`, which returns a Promise.
- Errors: listen with `player.on('error', e => e.detail)`, and handle the
  Promise returned by `player.open()` as well.
- Cleanup: call `player.destroy()` when the player is no longer needed. See
  the React sample.
- Plugins: get one with `player.getPlugin(id)`. Register custom plugins with
  `clpp.Player.registerPlugin(factory)` before creating the player.
- Values marked `TODO` (account keys, vendor SDK paths) must be filled in
  before a sample works.

## Examples

- [Basic playback](examples/basic.html): Load and play a DASH or HLS URL. This is the minimal setup.
- [React integration](examples/react/react.html): A React `Player` component with custom play/pause, a seek bar and fullscreen. Creates the player in `useEffect` and destroys it in the cleanup function.
- [Playlist](examples/playlist/playlist.html): `clpp.Playlist` plays DASH and HLS items back-to-back with `next()`, `previous()` and `goTo()`.
- [Custom plugin](examples/plugins/stats_overlay.html): Implements `clpp.PlayerPlugin` and `clpp.PlayerPluginFactory` (a stats overlay) and shows each plugin lifecycle callback.
- [Google IMA ads](examples/advertising/ima.html): Client-side pre-, mid- and post-roll ads from a VMAP ad tag, with ad events and the `clpp.ads.IAd` interface.
- [Thumbnails](examples/thumbnails/thumbnails.html): Seek-bar preview thumbnails for a DASH stream through the thumbnails plugin.
- [Subtitle text styling](examples/subtitles/text_style.html): Style subtitles with the `textStyle` setting (font, colors, edge type).
- [SRT subtitles](examples/subtitles/srt.html): Side-load an SRT file with `remoteTextTracks` and select it with `preferredTextLanguage`.
- [Conviva analytics](examples/analytics/conviva.html): Conviva integration through the `conviva` player config. The vendor SDK is not on npm.
- [Mux Data analytics](examples/analytics/muxdata.html): Mux Data integration through the `muxdata` player config, plus custom events.
- [NPAW v7 analytics](examples/analytics/npaw_v7.html): NPAW (Youbora) integration through the `npaw` player config, with a custom `errorFilter`.
- [Audio player](examples/audio/audio.html): Audio-only HLS in an `<audio>` element with `disableContainer: true` and custom controls.
